newsitem.title: CHINA: China corn harvest seen lower, total grain steady.
newsitem.headline: China corn harvest seen lower, total grain steady.

text.p: Drought across central and northeastern China would affect this year's corn crop but would not cut the overall grain harvest below forecast levels, an agricultural official said on Wednesday.

Corn had been affected in key producing areas such as central Henan and eastern Shandong provinces as well as across the northeast, Zhang Xinmin, an agricultural official with the State Statistical Bureau, told a news conference.
However, forecasts for the full-year grain harvest had taken into account less favourable weather this year, Zhang said.
The Ministry of Internal Trade has forecast grain output for this year at above 484 million tonnes, compared with a record 490 million tonnes last year.
Zhang said last year's total grain crop probably was slightly larger than the reported 490 million tonne level but he declined to give the difference.
The final figure would be released in September, he said.
